about: Take on the role of the mighty panda and tread your path unerringly. Skilfully dodge your attackers and sweep aside any creatures standing in your way – attack!
Discover the exciting world of our intrepid panda hero in this thrilling platform game. Funny, thrilling and action-packed!
• Four imaginatively designed worlds • More than 50 adventurous levels • Exciting boss fights on the last level of each world • Hours of highly addictive fun!
